<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbon atoms, I will first obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the `carbon_nmr_spectra` tool. Then I will retrieve typical chemical shift ranges for aromatic carbons with `retrieve_carbon_shifts`. By comparing the observed carbon signals to the aromatic range, I can count how many signals correspond to aromatic carbons, which gives the number of aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<action>carbon_nmr_spectra</action>
